_comment: Pinned third-party components for scripts/install-component.ps1. A download is refused when the size or the SHA-256 differs. sha256 null = not pinned yet: the script refuses to install (pin it after checking the file against the release page).

aria2.title: aria2 1.37.0 (торрент-клиент)
aria2.integrity: The publisher (maintainer account tatsuhiro-t) publishes no checksum or signature for the Windows archive and aria2c.exe is not Authenticode-signed. The hash was computed here on 2026-10-18 after downloading from the official GitHub release over HTTPS (size matched the release page, Windows Defender found nothing). It pins the file for later checks; it is NOT proof of authenticity.

llama.title: llama.cpp b11669, сборка для процессора (запуск локальной модели)
llama.integrity: The project publishes binaries only as pre-release builds (about 15 a day, tag bNNNN); its release marked stable (v0.7.0, published 2026-10-15) contains only nightly-tag.txt, which names b11669. b11669 is that stable pointer and was 3 days old when chosen. The SHA-256 is the digest GitHub computed for the uploaded asset (read from the GitHub API); the publisher gives no separate checksum file, so it proves the file is the one GitHub holds, not independent authenticity. Build provenance attestation: see docs/runbooks/local-ai.md.
